pickQuotationFirst: Choose the customer, then the quotation this is going against.
noQuotations: No issued quotation has anything left to send.
requestHint: What is going now, how it travels, and on what terms.
approveHint: The number SMAC gave the dispatch. That is what approves it, and it is what counts toward the month.
correctNumberTitle: Correct the SMAC dispatch number on {label}
correctNumberHint: The number as SMAC issued it. The month it counts in does not move, and the old one stays under What happened.
sameNumber: That is the number it already carries.
notApproved: It has no SMAC number until it is approved.
refuseHint: What is wrong with it? The rep reads this.

payment.noteRequired: Finance reads this one, so say what was agreed.

empty: No dispatches yet. Request one against an issued quotation.
emptyForQuotation: Nothing has been sent against this quotation yet.
needsItems: A dispatch needs at least one line with a quantity on it.
notFound: That dispatch is not there any more.
notWaiting: This request has already been answered.
quotationNotFound: That quotation is not there any more.
quotationNotIssued: A dispatch is raised against an issued quotation.
tooMuch: That is more than the quotation has left.
notOnQuotation: One of those lines is not on this quotation.
numberRequired: The SMAC dispatch number is what approves it.
supersededQuotation: That quotation has been revised — the dispatch goes against the latest one.
